Cube Storage Pioneers

Little Robots, Big Business

Since its inception in 1996, AutoStore™ has worked to improve warehouse efficiency. Today, the company’s key value proposition is to deliver an easy-to-use software powered cubic automatic storage and retrieval ecosystem.

The AutoStore solution is modular and flexible, and can automate any warehouse. The system offers a superior customer value proposition across operating metrics, ESG scores, and customer economics.
‍

elements.title: a house in Ohio (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that people traveled from as far away as Australia and the Netherlands to stay at a house in Ohio?

elements.title: hive cities (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that urbanists have used hive cities from the science-fiction universe of Warhammer 40,000 as an example of how vertical cities could become dystopian?

elements.title: Philippine embassy in Pretoria (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the Philippine embassy in Pretoria responded to a South African newspaper's denunciation of horse fighting in the Philippines by saying that the practice was already illegal?

elements.title: Jules Rabin (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that artisan baker Jules Rabin was inspired to bake bread after a 1971 visit to a commune in France where "they didn't speak of bread as holy, but they treated it as a holy object"?

elements.title: Tout est lumière (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Tout est lumière, a setting by Maurice Ravel for soprano, choir and orchestra of a poem by Victor Hugo, earned Ravel a place in the second round of the 1901 Prix de Rome?

elements.title: Tommy Cronin (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Tommy Cronin played both basketball and football in high school, in college, and professionally?

elements.title: Battle of Nanggulon (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the grave of a Dutch officer and his dog who were killed in the Battle of Nanggulon is a designated cultural object in Indonesia?
